Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
Not reliably, no, since the user isn't forced to put in a country when they register.

There are 121 users with no text at all in their "location".

You can find the 21 players that claim a location of France by following these steps:

1) Click this link:
www.vekn.net/index.php/component/comprofiler/userslist

2) Click on Search Users at the top right.

3) In the Location drop down box, choose Contains Phrase.

4) Type in the country name, and then click on Find Users.
